description: Land Aquisition -  Meemure, Ududumbara D/S Division, Kandy District Order No.88 of 2024.  Udagaladebokka, Minipe D/S Division, Kandy District. Order No.90 of 2024.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains specific orders for taking possession of described land parcels, including detailed descriptions of land boundaries, lot numbers, extents, and locations. While a minister is named, the core content focuses on land property matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette.
